annotation_review.review_method: Visual review of cropped BDD traffic-sign annotations; proposals were not accepted automatically
annotation_review.class_definition: Front-facing red octagonal stop signs, including legible STOP text and clear raised-hand stop signs; warning-symbol and no-entry signs excluded
annotation_review.other_candidate_policy: Exclude unverified images rather than turning uncertain signs into negative labels
limitations: Model-assisted candidate selection can miss stop signs
Small or occluded signs require further review
Bounding boxes inherit the source annotation policy

additional_review.review_method: Assistant visually inspected all 141 traffic-sign crops in four contact sheets; retained readable STOP or recognizable red octagonal hand stop faces. No-entry, yield, arrows, sign backs, warnings and ambiguous crops excluded.
additional_review.box_source: BDD100K official traffic-sign annotations; subclass supplied by visual review
additional_review.limitations: Teacher-assisted candidate selection biases coverage toward detectable stops; not an exhaustive stop-sign benchmark. Tiny, oblique or missed signs can remain unlabelled. International hand stop faces are included.

stop_sign_coverage: Model-assisted selection and visual verification; limited sample coverage
nuimages_stop_sign_coverage: Model-assisted incidental-stop audit; positive crops visually reviewed, possible missed signs remain
